description: Evidence manifest listing all artifacts generated during QA Sprint 4 validation. Includes screenshots, test reports, traces, and configuration files.

evidence.description: Login page rendering after Input/Checkbox style prop fix (BUG-QA4-CRIT-001). Confirms page loads without React error #62.
Playwright HTML test report containing full test results for all ~520 tests. Open index.html in browser to view.
Playwright trace files (.zip) for failed tests. Load in Playwright Trace Viewer to inspect network, console, and DOM state at failure point.
OTP page rendering without navigation state (BUG-QA4-HIGH-003). Shows blank content area where OTP input should appear.
Input and Checkbox components rendering correctly after style prop fix. Validates all input variants (text, email, password, checkbox).
Admin console page showing React error boundary after unauthorized access. Demonstrates lack of route guard (BUG-S3-MED-006).
Dashboard page showing placeholder content ('Welcome to your dashboard') with empty KPI cards.
Training platform index page with course listing and placeholder content.
Product catalog page with category filter active and product cards visible.
axe-core accessibility scan results. JSON file with violations, passes, and incomplete items per page.
Keyboard navigation test results. Logs Tab order, focus indicators, and Enter/Space activation for all pages.
Build time measurement: 11.89s for `vite build`. Includes duration, asset count, and bundle sizes.
Page load time measurements for all routes captured via Playwright `waitForLoadState`. Times in milliseconds.
Mock API endpoint validation results. HTTP status codes, response payload shapes, and latency for all mock endpoints.
Cross-browser test comparison (Chromium vs Firefox). Lists passing/failing tests per browser with failure reasons.
Home page rendered at 375px viewport width. Verifies responsive layout and hamburger menu behavior.
Home page rendered at 768px viewport width. Verifies tablet layout adaptation.
Registration page with terms gate checkbox active. Confirms checkbox required before submission.
Playwright configuration used for Sprint 4 test execution. Includes browser projects, test match patterns, and reporter settings.
QA Sprint 4 Executive Summary. High-level findings, pass rates, critical fixes, and recommendations.
